title: Answer
description:
Faith is the substance of things hoped for and the evidence of things not seen. What this account hopes for is still not seen: a city, a country, a promise not yet received.

The worlds were framed by the word of God. What is seen was made by what is not seen.

One brother’s gift was received and the other’s was not. The one who died still speaks, because God Himself spoke over his blood.

One man walked with God and was taken. To please God a person must believe that He is, and that He rewards those who seek Him.

Another was warned of things not yet seen, and he built. The building saved his house and condemned the world that refused the warning.
